-- big integer helpers using base 10^9 arrays (least significant first)
local BASE = 1000000000

local function fromstr(s)
  s = s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
  local a = {}
  local n = #s
  local i = n
  while i > 0 do
    local lo = math.max(1, i-8)
    a[#a+1] = tonumber(s:sub(lo, i))
    i = lo - 1
  end
  return a
end

local function norm(a)
  while #a > 1 and a[#a] == 0 do a[#a] = nil end
  return a
end

local function tostr(a)
  a = norm(a)
  local parts = { tostring(a[#a]) }
  for i = #a-1, 1, -1 do
    parts[#parts+1] = string.format("%09d", a[i])
  end
  return table.concat(parts)
end

local function mul(a, b)
  local c = {}
  for i = 1, #a do c[i + #b] = 0 end -- ensure length maybe
  for i = 1, #a do
    local ai = a[i]
    if ai ~= 0 then
      local carry = 0
      for j = 1, #b do
        local cur = c[i+j-1] or 0
        local v = cur + ai * b[j] + carry
        c[i+j-1] = v % BASE
        carry = math.floor(v / BASE)
      end
      local k = i + #b
      while carry > 0 do
        local cur = c[k] or 0
        local v = cur + carry
        c[k] = v % BASE
        carry = math.floor(v / BASE)
        k = k + 1
      end
    end
  end
  return norm(c)
end

-- mul by small number (fits in integer)
local function mulsmall(a, m)
  local carry = 0
  for i = 1, #a do
    local v = a[i] * m + carry
    a[i] = v % BASE
    carry = math.floor(v / BASE)
  end
  while carry > 0 do
    a[#a+1] = carry % BASE
    carry = math.floor(carry / BASE)
  end
  return norm(a)
end

-- mod by big number: use long division base BASE
local function mod(a, m)
  a = norm(a)
  m = norm(m)
  -- compare lengths
  local function cmp(a, b)
    if #a ~= #b then return a > b and 1 or -1 end
    for i = #a, 1, -1 do
      if a[i] ~= b[i] then return a[i] > b[i] and 1 or -1 end
    end
    return 0
  end
  -- simple repeated: do digit-by-digit long division
  local rem = {}
  for i = #a, 1, -1 do
    -- rem = rem*BASE + a[i]
    local carry = a[i]
    for j = 1, #rem do
      local v = rem[j] * BASE + carry
      rem[j] = v % BASE
      carry = math.floor(v / BASE)
    end
    while carry > 0 do
      rem[#rem+1] = carry % BASE
      carry = math.floor(carry / BASE)
    end
    norm(rem)
    -- subtract m* q where q found via binary search / approximation
    -- approximate: use top digits
    local lo, hi = 0, BASE-1
    -- need multiply m by q (small) then compare
    local function mulsmalloccal(x, q)
      local t = {}
      for k = 1, #x do t[k] = x[k] end
      local carry = 0
      for k = 1, #t do
        local v = t[k] * q + carry
        t[k] = v % BASE
        carry = math.floor(v / BASE)
      end
      while carry > 0 do t[#t+1] = carry % BASE; carry = math.floor(carry/BASE) end
      return norm(t)
    end
    while lo < hi do
      local mid = math.floor((lo + hi + 1)/2)
      local prod = mulsmalloccal(m, mid)
      if cmp(prod, rem) <= 0 then lo = mid else hi = mid - 1 end
    end
    if lo > 0 then
      local prod = mulsmalloccal(m, lo)
      local borrow = 0
      for j = 1, #rem do
        local v = rem[j] - (prod[j] or 0) - borrow
        if v < 0 then v = v + BASE; borrow = 1 else borrow = 0 end
        rem[j] = v
      end
      norm(rem)
    end
  end
  return norm(rem)
end

local A = fromstr("7926685613381132823756537228191667758153")
local B = fromstr("6536379771845492382175875568769168175327")
local P = mul(A, B)
local prod = tostr(P)

-- 30!
local f = {1}
for n = 1, 30 do mulsmall(f, n) end
local M = fromstr("984738291748392817483921")
local r = mod(f, M)
local rem = tostr(r)

print("30! =", tostr(f))
sys.exit{report = prod .. "," .. rem}
"}

local BASE = 1000000

local function fromstr(s)
  s = s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
  local a = {}
  local n = #s
  local i = n
  while i > 0 do
    local lo = math.max(1, i-(#tostring(BASE)-1))
    a[#a+1] = tonumber(s:sub(lo, i))

end
